subject: Mutual action plan: environment provisioning and close timeline (API keys, org, IP allowlist, peering)
messages:
From: Dana Morris <dana.morris@helioshealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and environment needs

Hannah — thanks for the quick sync this morning. Per our conversation, procurement will need a short checklist for the POC environment we can share with security and network (they asked specifically about API key handling, org-level permissions, IP allowlist, and VPC peering).

Can you send a one-page MAP milestone table and the VPC peering template? We'd like to lock the network ticket by EOD Friday and aim to start the POC by Feb 22. Procurement also requested an estimated run-rate for the duration of the trial (2–3 weeks).

Appreciate it — Dana

--
Dana Morris
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
Helios Health
Dana.Morris@helioshealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morris <dana.morris@helioshealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and environment needs

Dana — forwarding our MAP checklist and a VPC peering template. High level items below so your network and security teams can triage quickly: 

- Org & accounts: we'll create a Helios Org in our console and invite two admin users (network-sec@helioshealth.com and integration-admin@helioshealth.com).
- API keys: scoped API key for POC with expiration (30 days) and key rotation guidance. We will not share long-lived keys.
- IP allowlist: please provide egress public IPs or set of CIDR ranges; we recommend a narrow set for the POC.
- VPC peering: template attached; we support AWS VPC peering and AWS PrivateLink (we can discuss which is preferred).
- Network timeline: expected peer acceptance + routing check = ~48–72 hours once you open the ticket.

Attached: rwi-map-environment-checklist.xlsx (MAP milestones + owners), vpc-peering-template.txt (network parameters). I've also added estimated token/run-rate sample for a 3-week trial in the spreadsheet.

Next steps: if procurement approves the checklist I can spin up the Helios Org and issue the scoped API key. Can you confirm the primary network contact and the tentative ticket number?

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morris <dana.morris@helioshealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and environment needs

Dana — quick technical notes for your network team: 

1) VPC peering params to confirm in the template: AWS account ID, VPC ID, proposed CIDR for routing, and desired tenancy. We recommend using a dedicated peering connection for the POC to avoid route overlap.
2) IP allowlist: Redwood egress IPs for the POC are listed in the template under "redwood-egress-ips". If you need static egress from Helios to Redwood, provide the Helios CIDRs and we'll update inbound rules.
3) Org setup: when Hannah creates the Helios Org we will assign the integration-admin role which has limited token minting rights (can't rotate org master keys).

I'll be available for a 30-min call this afternoon if the network folks want to walk the peering steps.

-Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Dana Morris <dana.morris@helioshealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, procure@helioshealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and environment needs

Thanks Hannah / Marcus — procurement has the checklist and asked that we add a single-line summary of data residency and retention for the trial. Network opened ticket NET-7831 (assigned to Omar Ruiz). Omar is copied in the ticket but not on this thread yet — I'll ask him to reach out directly.

Procurement also asked for a short note on SLA expectations during trial versus production. Can you add a one-paragraph SLA note in the MAP doc?

We'll target the Feb 22 start but it depends on NET-7831 outcomes.

-Dana
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morris <dana.morris@helioshealth.com>, Omar.Ruiz@helioshealth.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, procure@helioshealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and environment needs

Dana / Omar — attaching an updated MAP spreadsheet with: milestone owners, a one-line data residency & retention statement, and a short SLA summary for POC (best-effort monitoring, 99% availability goal for our hosted POC, production SLAs require Dedicated contract).

Omar — welcome, and thanks for opening NET-7831. Quick ask for your team: please confirm the VPC CIDR and whether Helios prefers AWS peering or PrivateLink. If you can reply with the preferred option and the CIDR by EOD Thursday (11 Feb) we can proceed to create the Helios Org and issue the scoped API key the same day.

Attachments: rwi-map-environment-checklist.xlsx, vpc-peering-template.txt

Thanks — Hannah
